passages.text: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins, in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
passages.sermon:
You were dead because of your trespasses and sins.
You once lived in these sins.
You followed the ways of this world.
You followed the ruler who has power over the air.
This ruler is a spirit.
This spirit now works in the sons of disobedience.
passages.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας

passages.text: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
passages.sermon:
All of us once lived among those who disobey God.
We followed the desires of our flesh.
We did what our bodies and minds wanted.
We were, by nature, children of wrath.
We were like everyone else.
passages.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν καὶ ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί

passages.text: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
passages.sermon:
God is rich in mercy.
God has great love for us.
God loved us with this great love.
We were dead because of our trespasses.
God made us alive with Christ.
God did this even when we were dead in our trespasses.
God saved us by His grace.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι

passages.text: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus, in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power and mercy.
God raised us up with Christ Jesus.
God seated us with Christ in the heavenly realms.
God did this so that He might show His great grace.
God wants to display the surpassing riches of His grace.
God shows this grace by His kindness to us.
God shows this kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
God will display His grace and kindness in the coming ages.
passages.original: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.
passages.sermon:
God saves you by His grace.
You receive this salvation through faith.
You do not save yourselves.
Salvation is God’s gift.
You do not earn it by your works.
No one can boast about saving themselves.
passages.original: Τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν Θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται

passages.text: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
passages.sermon:
God made us.
We are His workmanship.
God created us in Christ Jesus.
He made us to do good works.
God prepared these good works beforehand.
God wants us to live by doing these good works.
passages.original: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ Θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν

passages.text: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)— remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
passages.sermon:
You are Gentiles by birth.
People call you "uncircumcised."
Those who are called "circumcised" do this.
Their circumcision is done by human hands.
Remember your past condition.
At that time, you were without Christ.
You were separated from the people of Israel.
You were strangers to the covenants of promise.
You had no hope.
You were without God in the world.
passages.original: Διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ποτὲ ὑμεῖς τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου ὅτι ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ

passages.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
passages.sermon:
You were once far from God.
You did not belong to Christ Jesus.
Now you are in Christ Jesus.
God has brought you near.
He did this through the blood of Christ.
passages.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ

passages.text: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He extinguished their hostility.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ is our peace.
He made Jews and Gentiles into one people.
He broke down the wall that divided them.
This wall was hostility between them.
He destroyed this hostility in His own body.
He abolished the law of commandments and rules.
He did this so He could create one new person from the two groups.
He made peace between them.
He reconciled both groups to God.
He did this in one body through the cross.
He put their hostility to death through Himself.
passages.original: Αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν αὑτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ

passages.text: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ came.
He preached peace.
He preached peace to you who were far away from God.
He preached peace to those who were near to God.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς

passages.text: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ gives us access to God the Father.
He does this for both Jews and Gentiles.
We come to the Father through Jesus.
We come by one Spirit.
The Holy Spirit unites us as we approach God.
passages.original: ὅτι δι’ αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ Πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα

passages.text: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household, built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
passages.sermon:
You are not strangers now.
You are not foreigners now.
You are fellow citizens with the saints.
You belong to God’s household.
God’s household is built on a foundation.
The apostles and prophets laid this foundation.
Christ Jesus Himself is the cornerstone of this foundation.
passages.original: Ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι ἀλλὰ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
passages.sermon:
Christ Jesus is the cornerstone.
He holds everything together.
In Christ, the whole building fits together.
This building grows.
It becomes a holy temple.
This temple belongs to the Lord.
passages.original: ἐν ᾧ πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν Κυρίῳ

passages.text: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
passages.sermon:
God builds you together with others.
He does this in Christ.
You become a dwelling place for God.
God lives in you by His Spirit.
passages.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν Πνεύματι
